title: Why are Filipino women having fewer children?
summary: An expert says the Philippines' era of overpopulation is over

blocks.text: An expert says the Philippines' era of overpopulation is over

MANILA, Philippines – In 2025, more women in the Philippines are choosing to have only one child or remain child-free. This aligns with the Philippine Statistics Authority’s report, which found that the country’s fertility rate fell from 4.1 in 1993 to just 1.7 in 2025.

blocks.caption: No kids, no apologies: Why Filipino women are opting out of motherhood

blocks.text: What happened to the “overpopulated” Philippines? And what could a declining birth rate mean for future generations? Watch this explainer by Eirene Manatlao to find out. – Rappler.com

blocks.caption: As Asia grays, can an aging Philippines avoid its neighbors’ fate?
